modalities.evidence: EEG recordings from a phoneme discrimination task
identified stimuli with a button-press response
TMS was applied using a Magstim Super Rapid Plus1 stimulator

output.population: Healthy control participants across two studies: 8 participants (P01-P08) in 2019 and 16 participants (S01-S16) in 2021
output.summary: EEG recordings from a phoneme discrimination task combined with transcranial magnetic stimulation, collected across two studies using single phonemes, consonant-vowel and vowel-consonant pairs, real words and pseudowords.
